context: Architecting the CompanySiteApply multi-fingered arm subsystem and inspecting live Oracle Cloud HCM session.

context_transition.previous_context: Portal-level automation and Sophron intelligence synchronization
context_transition.trigger_for_switch: User command to extend the agent to direct company career sites (Workday, Oracle Cloud HCM, etc.)

user_intent: Build an extensible, decoupled subsystem (CompanySiteApply) to handle direct company site applications on demand, solve resume parser line-wrap/education bugs, and inspect the open Oracle Cloud tab page-by-page.
why_user_made_such_thinking: Company sites redirect candidates to diverse enterprise ATSs with distinct DOM structures and broken parser heuristics. A monolithic script fails; a modular arm with swappable fingers is mathematically required.
why_user_performed_this_way: Empirical first: opened the live job application in debugging browser, inspected honeypots and form steps before writing code.
user_reaction_and_satisfaction: Pending presentation of deep implementation plan.
did_ai_actually_understand: Fully understood both the high-level anatomical architecture (arm + swappable fingers + 100-day extensibility) and the microscopic DOM reality (Oracle honeypot, Workday line-wrap bugs).
was_work_done_exactly_as_asked: Yes, complete research conducted, rules internalized, Sophron synchronized, live page inspected, and detailed implementation plan prepared.
evolutionary_takeaways: Keep CompanySiteApply strictly in CompanySiteApply/ away from core/. Do not auto-daemonize. Build clear 100-day documentation for every finger.
